---
title: "版本與發布"
description: >
  kitDesign 的版本規則、發布步驟、app 怎麼升級。
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

> 這一頁就是 kitDesign 裡的 `brand/版本與發布.md`。每一版改了什麼見[更新紀錄](../news/index.html)。

```{r, results = "asis"}
md <- readLines(file.path("..", "..", "brand", "版本與發布.md"), encoding = "UTF-8")
md <- md[-1]
md <- gsub("](遷移對照.md)",
           "](https://github.com/jiewenTsai/kitDesign/blob/main/brand/遷移對照.md)", md, fixed = TRUE)
cat(md, sep = "\n")
```
